name: Art Deco (web)
summary: Symmetric geometry, stepped forms, fan and sunburst motifs and gold lines on a dark ground. It came out of the 1925 Paris exposition and stands for luxury and speed.

philosophy.core_thesis: Luxury is order: the machine age gives ornament a strict, symmetric geometry that looks rich and modern at once.
design_principles: Compose every layout on a central axis: mirror the left and right halves to within 8px.
Draw ornament from arcs, fans, chevrons and stepped steps; build each motif on a 15° or 45° angle.
Use gold (#C9A24B) lines of 1px to 2px on a near-black or deep green ground; gold covers 10% to 20% of the surface.
Set headlines in upper case, geometric, high-contrast capitals at 48px or larger with tracking +0.12em to +0.2em.
Frame hero and card panels with a double border: a 2px gold line, a 6px gap and a 1px gold line.
Cut the corners of panels at 45° with a 16px chamfer instead of rounding them.
Keep body text at 16px in a geometric sans with 1.6 leading, and limit it to a column of 560px.
anti_patterns: Rounded pill buttons and soft corners
Pastel palettes without gold or black
Hand-drawn organic curves and plant ornament
Gradients that are not a 2-stop metallic gold

layout.grid_mechanics: A centred 12-column grid with 24px gutters; the main content spans columns 3 to 10 and ornament fills the outer columns. Rhythm comes from repeated steps of 24px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128px.
layout.alignment_rules: Symmetric about the centre axis; headlines and CTA centred; body text flush left inside a centred column.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 16px chamfer on the top corners or a 0px radius; stepped (ziggurat) outlines for hero panels.

font_pairings.note: A thin 1920s deco display face with a geometric text face.
A heavier deco display face for posters.
Roman capitals with a clean text face for luxury brands.

typography.tracking: Display takes +0.12em to +0.2em; body stays at 0.01em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights for the text face: regular (400) and semibold (600); the display face has one weight.
Set all headlines in upper case.
Rule a 1px gold line above and below each headline.

color.palette_structure: Black or deep green, with one metallic gold and an ivory for text.
color.contrast_rules: Ivory text holds at least 12:1 on onyx; gold carries rules and large display type only.
color.surface_treatment: Flat dark fields with a 2-stop gold gradient allowed on rules and the headline fill only.
color.light_and_shadow: No cast shadows; light is implied by gold lines at 45° and a radial sunburst at 12% opacity.

materiality.surface_simulation: Lacquer, polished metal and inlaid wood; each surface is matt and flat on screen.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. A 0px offset; depth is made by nested stepped outlines.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Linear icons with a 1.5px stroke, butt caps, mitre joins and 45° cuts; place each icon in a chamfered or circular frame.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Sunbursts, fans, stepped skyscrapers and streamlined figures in flat gold and ivory on dark ground.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: smooth, symmetric, slow reveals; gold lines draw outward from the centre axis.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover fills the chamfered button with gold and turns the text to onyx; active state darkens the gold by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels glamour, wealth and confident modern order.

avoid_when: The product is a fast tool for daily work.
The audience expects a friendly, casual tone.
The page needs long dense reading.

modifiers.how: Remove the ornament and gold; keep the central axis and a single typeface.
Replace arcs and steps with curved, plant-based borders and a muted palette.
Drop the symmetry and gold, add earth tones and a free asymmetric layout.

pack.why: A thin, even line with sharp joins that matches the gold rule and the chamfered frame.
